newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: S. Korean heads U.N. Kashmir observer group.
newsitem.headline: S. Korean heads U.N. Kashmir observer group.

text.p: South Korean Major-General Ahn Choung-Jun has been appointed chief of the U.N. Military Observer Group in India and Pakistan (UNMOGIP), one of the oldest and smallest U.N. field missions, it was disclosed on Tuesday.
UNMOGIP was set up in 1949 to supervise a ceasefire between India and Pakistan in Kashmir and now consists of 44 military observers.
Ahn's appointment was confirmed in a recent exchange of letters between Secretary-General Kofi Annan and the president of the Security Council made public on Tuesday.
He succeeds Major-General Alfonso Pessolano of Italy, who has been UNMOGIP's chief military observer since December 1994.
